title: New York State Education Department (NYSED)
text: Platform: Drupal 7 CMS, Axe DevTools, WAVE, JAWS, NVDA, DHS Trusted Tester, SEO, Web Analytics, Agile, ISO 9001:2015 Client Overview The New York State Education Department (NYSED) oversees public education, professional licensing, higher education, and cultural institutions across New York State. Its digital presence serves millions of residents, educators, professionals, and institutions through a large multi department governance structure with centralized administrative oversight. The engagement required coordination across numerous program offices while maintaining strict accessibility and compliance standards, closely paralleling Alleghany County's multi department website governance and public service requirements. The Challenge NYSED requires web accessibility and Drupal CMS consultancy support to improve accessibility compliance, navigation, content governance, and overall website performance. The engagement included accessibility remediation, information architecture, SEO, analytics, and ongoing CMS support across multiple program offices under centralized administrative oversight, along with a phased compliance roadmap and accessible CMS templates for long term internal use. Our Solution The project was delivered through a phased and streamlined approach. D Group supported NYSED with planning, implementing, and maintaining website updates within the Drupal 7 CMS, including ongoing management of web pages, videos, PDFs, forms, and other digital content across department owned sections. Content was published through department approved templates while maintaining compliance with NYSED governance standards. D Group coordinated directly with program offices and content experts to review updates, facilitate approvals, and support cross department collaboration. Accessibility remediation covered websites, forms, PDFs, and Microsoft Office documents for WCAG 2.1 AA and ADA Title II compliance. D Group also served as the liaison between NYSED and its technology platform, supporting web analytics, CMS governance, and ongoing content management aligned with departmental objectives. D Group also delivered a phased compliance roadmap and accessible Drupal 7 template library that enabled NYSED's internal team to independently manage ongoing accessibility and content updates after project completion.

title: Acme United Corporation
text: CASE STUDY 01: ACME UNITED CORPORATION WordPress CMS | Ongoing A publicly traded manufacturer's corporate website serving investors, job seekers, brand partners, and consumers across ten brands and across multiple U.S. and international locations. Website: https://acmeunited.com/ Client Overview Acme United Corporation (NASDAQ: ACU) is a publicly traded global manufacturer whose brand portfolio includes First Aid Only, Westcott, Clauss, DMT Sharpeners, PhysiciansCare, Spill Magic, Elite First Aid, Safety Made, Central, and Med Nap. The company operates from five U.S. locations, Shelton CT, Marlborough MA, Vancouver WA, Santa Ana CA, and Smyrna TN, and serves investors, job seekers, brand managers, and general consumers through a single unified corporate web presence. The site simultaneously satisfies SEC level investor relations requirements, multi-location employment functions, multi brand product presentation, innovation storytelling, and ongoing company communications. The Challenge Acme United required a unified WordPress platform that could organize the complexity of a publicly traded, ten-brand manufacturer under one CMS, managed by a small internal team without dedicated developer support. The site needed to serve distinct audience types simultaneously, integrate with a third-party investor relations platform without disrupting navigation, support multi-location employment listings manageable by individual office, and provide active news and content publishing that non-technical staff could operate independently. Our Solution D Group designed and built a custom WordPress site whose information architecture directly reflects Acme United's organizational structure. Navigation covers Company, Our Brands, Innovation, Investor Relations, and Employment, each with multi-tier sub-navigation. The Investor Relations section integrates with gcs-web.com without any visible platform seam. Employment listings are organized by office location with each site managing postings independently. An active news section supports ongoing publishing without developer involvement. D Group provides ongoing WordPress hosting, maintenance, and content support. Key Deliverables • Custom WordPress theme built to Acme United brand standards • Multi-tier nested navigation covering ten brands, five functions, and five U.S. locations • Third-party investor relations platform integration with gcs-web.com • Multi-location employment listings with independent management per office • Active news and company announcements publishing system • Innovation section covering cutting, coating, first aid, and sharpening technology • Mobile-responsive design across all devices and browsers • Ongoing WordPress hosting, maintenance, and content support Outcome Live corporate WordPress site actively maintained. Non-technical staff manage all routine content updates across all brands, locations, and functions independently. Site last modified June 2026.

title: Libman Education
text: CASE STUDY 02: LIBMAN EDUCATION WordPress CMS | Healthcare Education Platform | Active Maintenance A WordPress platform for a national healthcare education organization with deep clinical content taxonomy and external LMS portal integration. Website: https://libmaneducation.com/ Client Overview Libman Education provides specialized training, certification programs, and eLearning libraries to healthcare coding professionals, revenue cycle managers, compliance officers, and clinical documentation specialists at leading healthcare organizations across the United States. Their catalog spans Coding (ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT and E/M, Anesthesia, Behavioral Health, Cardiovascular, Trauma, and others), eLearning Libraries, Specialized and Job-Specific training, and Assessments, with multiple certification pathways and exam preparation programs under each category. The organizational depth of this content is comparable in complexity to a multi-department government website. The Challenge Libman Education required a WordPress site capable of organizing a deeply layered clinical content hierarchy while remaining manageable for non-technical administrators updating it regularly. A critical requirement was seamlessly integrating with an external LMS student portal at le2.libmaneducation.com so users could transition from course browsing to authenticated enrollment without a disruptive experience. The site needs to remain current with frequent updates managed by non-technical staff. Our Solution D Group built the site on WordPress with WP Rocket for performance optimization and a hierarchical navigation system organized by clinical specialty, learning format, and certification pathway. The external LMS integration at le2.libmaneducation.com maintains brand and visual continuity as students cross into the student portal. The CMS was configured for non-technical administrators managing course pages, library subscriptions, and certification resources. Key Deliverables • WordPress CMS with WP Rocket performance optimization • Multi-level content taxonomy across Coding, Libraries, Specialized, and Assessments • External LMS student portal integration at le2.libmaneducation.com • Course catalog covering ICD-10, CPT, Anesthesia, Behavioral Health, Cardiovascular, Trauma, and more • Exam preparation and certification pathway pages for CCS, CCS-P, CIRCC, CRC, and others • eLearning library subscription and matrix navigation pages • Skip-to-content and baseline accessibility implementation • Mobile-responsive design across all devices • Active ongoing maintenance, last updated March 2026 Outcome Active WordPress site serving a national healthcare audience. Non-technical administrators manage all content independently. External LMS portal integration fully operational.

title: SmartCompliance
text: Client Overview SmartCompliance is a First Aid Only brand under Acme United Corporation, manufacturing OSHA and ANSI certified first aid cabinets and a companion digital compliance management platform called SafetyHub. Customers include safety officers, facilities managers, and procurement professionals responsible for maintaining regulatory compliance at industrial, healthcare, and commercial facilities. The site must communicate a technically complex, compliance driven product to audiences with varying levels of regulatory familiarity. The Challenge SmartCompliance needed a WordPress site translating OSHA and ANSI compliance standards into clear, accessible content for non-specialists while maintaining credibility for procurement professionals who need regulatory specifics. The site also needed to bridge the web experience with the SafetyHub mobile app so users could move from product research to active compliance management. Everything had to be managed by a non-technical marketing team without development support. Our Solution D Group designed a WordPress site organized around user outcomes: compliance assurance, cost savings, and ease of management. An interactive tooltip product tour allows users to explore features without reading lengthy documentation. Embedded video walkthroughs explain how the cabinet and SafetyHub app work together. Integration links guide users from web content to the SafetyHub mobile platform. Content architecture serves both compliance officers needing regulatory detail and facilities managers who need a simple solution. Key Deliverables • Custom WordPress theme aligned to SmartCompliance brand standards • Interactive hover-activated tooltip product tour • Embedded product and compliance video walkthroughs • SafetyHub mobile app integration and cross-platform content pathway • OSHA and ANSI compliance documentation and downloadable resources • Multi-audience content architecture for compliance officers and facilities managers • Mobile-responsive design for workplace and field use • Non-technical CMS configuration for marketing team management Outcome Live website on WordPress platform serving national workplace safety audience. Non-technical staff manage all content updates independently. SafetyHub app integration is fully operational.

title: New York State Office of Mental Health (OMH)
text: Platform: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, JAWS, NVDA, cross-browser testing on Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge Client Overview The New York State Office of Mental Health promotes mental health services across New York State, operates psychiatric centers statewide, and oversees thousands of community-based programs. Its digital presence serves users with cognitive, visual, motor, and emotional challenges, making accessible and mobile responsive design a critical public access requirement. The Challenge OMH required web development consulting for responsive mobile coding and cross-browser compatibility across their web applications. All code was required to meet state accessibility standards as a core requirement from the outset. The engagement demanded clean, maintainable, object-oriented code with full documentation and staff training support. Our Solution D Group provided full-scope accessible responsive web development for OMH using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery. Accessible code standards were applied from the ground up. Layouts are responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile. Cross-browser compatibility was tested and verified on Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge. D Group performed unit and system integration testing in both development and production environments, contributed to software documentation, and supported training of OMH development staff. Key Deliverables • Accessible HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript development as a core foundational requirement • Object-oriented JavaScript and CSS for maintainable, reusable code • Mobile-responsive layout across desktop, tablet, and mobile • Cross-browser testing on Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge • Unit and system integration testing in development and production • User interface debugging and requirements analysis • Software documentation and manual user contributions • OMH development staff training for internal capacity building Outcome Accessible, mobile-responsive web applications delivered to a state agency serving users with mental health conditions and disabilities.
